active_initiative.name: Async Concurrency Substrate — rebuild the relay into per-repo isolation domains with path-scoped interlock, lease locks, and async-by-default commit (PCR-OPS-052)

contract.runner_scope: Enact PCR-OPS-052 in seven independently-shippable stages, one staged lane per stage, in order 0→6. Rebuild the git relay from a volume-global singleton (one queue, one lock, one interlock marker for all 16 repos) into per-repo isolation domains with a path-scoped interlock, lease-based orphan-proof locking, async-by-default commit with session-end receipt reconciliation, enforced single-writer projections, and (gated) bare-main + merge-queue integration. The relay trust boundary (AI → Intent → Relay → GitHub, deny-by-default, relay-only source control, non-waivable Steward/Identity-Firewall gates) is unchanged throughout — this initiative changes concurrency topology, never authorization. One pattern across all repos, parametrized by operations/repo-class-registry.md.
contract.stop_line: Each stage that touches the commit/push substrate (Stages 2, 3, 4, 6) requires non-waivable Security Steward review before go-live (PCR-OPS-045 discipline) and stages on its own lane for CEO promotion. Stage 6 (bare-main + merge-queue) additionally requires a parallel-run rehearsal before cutover AND is gated on a measured decision: proceed only if the Stage 0 metrics, after Stages 1–5, still show residual integration contention that justifies the build.
